column7: \record Seq (A : Nat -> \Type) (f : \Pi {n : Nat} -> A n -> A (suc n))
\data SeqColimit (s : Seq) | inSC {n : Nat} (s.A n) | quotSC {n : Nat} (x : s.A n) : inSC x = inSC (s.f x)
\func flattening {s : Seq.{u}} (P : SeqColimit s -> \Type u) : total = (\Sigma (w : SeqColimit s) (P w))

\data TotalSeqColimit (j : I) | tinSC {n : Nat} (x : s.A n) (P (inSC x)) | tquotSC {n : Nat} (x : s.A n) (i : I) (w : P (quotSC x (I.squeeze i j))) \elim i { | left => tinSC x w | right => tinSC (s.f x) (coe2 (\lam i => P (quotSC x i)) j w right) }
\func totalSeqColimitRight : QEquiv {TotalSeqColimit right} {\Sigma (w : SeqColimit s) (P w)}
\lemma helper {n : Nat} (x : s.A n) : TruncP (Fib (inSC {s} {0}) (inSC x))
\lemma constantMaps (s : Seq) (p : \Pi (n : Nat) -> \Sigma (x : s.A (suc n)) (\Pi (a : s.A n) -> s.f a = x)) : Contr (SeqColimit s)
